summary: This bill directs the Secretary of State, in consultation with other agencies, to support Western Hemisphere countries in diversifying their semiconductor supply chains by providing diplomatic assistance and improving infrastructure for critical mineral mining, processing, and semiconductor testing and packaging.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to diversify semiconductor supply chains in the Western Hemisphere by encouraging investment and enhancing regulatory environments. This promotes more robust and varied trade relationships for critical components, aligning with free trade principles by fostering competitive markets and integration.

The bill directs the Secretary of State and other agencies to support Western Hemisphere countries in diversifying their semiconductor supply chains, including through diplomatic support and direct assistance via the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation. This constitutes an increase in foreign aid, albeit targeted at specific economic development goals.
